Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer states that Walt Mossberg was 63 when the first iPad was released. The Predicted Answer identifies Walt Mossberg as the journalist, provides his birthdate (March 27, 1947), and explains that he was 62 when he reviewed the iPad in January 2010 and turned 63 by the iPad's retail release on April 3, 2010. Therefore, it directly includes the essential fact from the Ground Truth—that Mossberg was 63 at the time of the iPad's release.

Decision: TRUE
